Pulse Remote for Android — control your Mac running Pulse from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Pulse › Tools › Pulse Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- test(remote-app): the settings page scrolls through the new Files on this phone section
- test(remote-app): browsing server, browser, settings and screens; live browse harness; 1.3.0+4
- feat(remote-app): browse the Mac's files and let the Mac browse this phone
- feat(remote): phones browse and change Mac files, the Mac browses phones (native)
- feat(remote-app): browsing core — protocol names, paged listing, confined phone storage, browse.request handler
- docs(remote): two-way file browsing protocol (Browsing, 3.3 / Remote 1.3)
